nodes.description: Owner address declared in Ownable; the privileged account checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pause flag of Pausable; when true, whenNotPaused gates all token movement functions.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; written by _transfer and the constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 holding spending approvals; read/written by transferFrom and allowance functions.
Initial total supply 1000000000 * 10**18 minted to the deployer in the MTKToken constructor.
Mapping address => LockMeta (lockType plus dynamic LockItem array) used by LockToken._transfer to block locked balances.
Caller-controlled address; used for owner checks, as the transfer source, allowance owner and constructor beneficiary.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used as the lock expiry condition inside LockToken._transfer.
Ownable function guarded by onlyOwner that reassigns the owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Ownable function guarded by onlyOwner that sets owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function setting paused = true so that whenNotPaused gated transfers revert.
onlyOwner function setting paused = false, re-enabling token transfers.
BaseToken internal _transfer: validates to != address(0), debits/credits balanceOf with SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Public whenNotPaused transfer moving value from msg.sender to the to parameter via the virtual _transfer.
Public whenNotPaused transferFrom: decrements allowance[from][msg.sender] then moves tokens through _transfer.
Public whenNotPaused approve setting allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emitting Approval.
Public whenNotPaused increaseAllowance adding addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender.
Public whenNotPaused decreaseAllowance subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for spender.
LockToken override of _transfer that inspects lockData[from] and block.timestamp before calling super._transfer.
onlyOwner lock() that resets and repopulates lockData[lockAddress] with endtime/remain pairs and emits Lock.
MTKToken constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender and assigning owner = msg.sender.
Payable fallback function of MTKToken that unconditionally reverts.
block.timestamp comparison against item.endtime combined with a remain threshold check in LockToken._transfer.
balanceOf[from].sub(value) SafeMath subtraction executed in BaseToken._transfer, mutating holder balances.
lockData[lockAddress].lockItems.length = 0 array truncation followed by push of new LockItem structs in lock().
allowance[from][msg.sender].sub(value) SafeMath subtraction executed in transferFrom before the transfer.
